title: PDF opens in viewer instead of downloading
description:
View PDF from the pipe chart (and selecting a PDF in the media viewer) now forces an inline application/pdf preview. Wasabi objects that were stored as octet-stream no longer trigger a browser download — the PDF stays in the sleek media overlay with Exit back to video.

Who is affected: PipeShare users opening report PDFs on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: PDF preview presigns request inline Content-Type / Content-Disposition.
Pipe chart View PDF loads a same-origin PDF blob so the iframe displays instead of downloading.
Exit still returns from the PDF overlay to the video.
